verbatim_quote.original: خب این کار رو بکن وقتی پروکسی عوض میشه کانکشن های قدیمی رو ببند هم حالت rr و هم حالت خودکار این رو تسکش کن و انجامش بده خودکار
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Do this: when the proxy changes, close the old connections — both in rr mode and automatic mode. Task it and do it automatically.

extracted_decision.summary: On every balancer selection change, close connections still chained to the previous node, in both the manual (rr/skip) and automatic (timer) paths, through one shared code path.
extracted_decision.rationale: Traffic must move to the new proxy immediately instead of waiting for old connections to drain.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Closing connections causes a brief traffic blip; surgical per-id close limits it.
